'''Valdris''' is a Rhovlandian river-valley region associated with the [[Geslariena]] language.

The extracted Geslariena source links Valdris to river communities, agricultural plains, seasonal cycles, navigation vocabulary, and the [[Geslariena Folk Ballads]].

== Draft Scope ==

This page preserves Valdris as a cultural-geography anchor. It does not yet establish a final map location, administrative rank, capital, noble house, or 1994 demographic profile.
